item.name: Get activity feed of user B

exec: pm.test("Body is an array", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(Array.isArray(b)).to.be.true; });
pm.test("Feed contains the review", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.some(a => a.type === "ALBUM_REVIEW")).to.be.true; });
pm.test("Feed contains the rating", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.some(a => a.type === "ALBUM_RATING")).to.be.true; });
pm.test("Has error message", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(typeof b.error === "string").to.be.true; });
pm.test("Error mentions title", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.error.includes("title")).to.be.true; });
